title: Correction: Neonatal blood lead concentration predicts medium term lead-related outcomes in children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning: A retrospective cohort study in Northern Nigeria.
ehr_evidence: This text is a correction statement that only revises the Funding and Competing Interests statements of a previously published retrospective cohort study; it presents no data analysis or named data source.
summary: This is a correction to the funding and competing interest statements of the 2023 retrospective cohort study on neonatal blood lead concentration predicting medium-term lead-related outcomes in children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning in Northern Nigeria.
limitations: This is a correction notice with no original data, results, or methods presented in the text.
The original study's data source and design are not described here.
